By a blind LLM accent judge on real dubbing data, reweighting classifier-free guidance between reference and text, and its variants, stay near one identity-accent trade-off curve; we score a method by its speaker similarity above that curve at equal accent (ΔSIM). Across four open TTS models AAG lies above the curve: on OmniVoice ΔSIM is +0.11 to +0.27 on three test sets (accent 3.51 to 4.28 on a 1-5 scale at speaker similarity 0.29, where reweighting keeps 0.02); MaskGCT and CosyVoice 2 also lie above their curves, and on F5-TTS it is more native than any reweighting setting. An LLM-free language-ID measure and a twelve-listener panel agree. A premise test and the reach of a model's own curve indicate in advance whether and roughly how much AAG can gain, predicting the one model where it gains nothing (X-Voice).

ru.title: Избавляемся от акцента в синтезе речи с помощью векторной аналогии
ru.desc: В статье решается проблема утечки акцента при кроссязычном синтезе речи с нулевым обучением. Авторы предлагают метод Accent Analogy Guidance (AAG) — стратегия выборки без обучения, которая вычитает направление акцента, оценённое из собственных предсказаний модели для одного голоса, отрендеренного на двух языках, оставляя только акцент. Метод оценивается на основе слепого LLM-судьи на реальных данных дубляжа и показывает улучшение сходства спикера выше кривой компромисса идентичность-акцент на четырёх моделях синтеза речи. Результаты подтверждены языковым идентификатором без LLM и панелью из двенадцати слушателей.

en.title: Enhancing Cross-Lingual TTS with Accent Analogy Guidance
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenge of cross-lingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) where the accent from the reference voice can influence the generated speech in a different language. The authors introduce a novel technique called accent analogy guidance (AAG), which helps to isolate and cancel out the accent from the synthetic voice by using predictions from the model itself. By employing a blind LLM accent judge and adjusting classifier-free guidance, the method aims to improve speaker similarity while maintaining accent consistency. The results show that AAG outperforms existing methods across multiple TTS models, achieving higher speaker similarity scores without compromising accent quality.

zh.title: 提升跨语言语音合成的口音一致性
zh.desc: 在跨语言零样本文本到语音合成中，参考音调会影响目标语音。我们提出了一种名为口音类比引导（AAG）的无训练采样器，它通过从模型自身的预测中减去一个估计的口音方向，使得合成语音在两种语言中保持一致。通过盲评的方式，我们评估了不同方法在说话者相似性上的表现，发现AAG在多个开放的文本到语音模型中表现优异。我们的实验结果表明，AAG能够有效提高语音合成的自然度和口音一致性。

papers.title: Harness-Aware Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Language model agents are deployed with a harness, the software around the model that manages its context, tools, and feedback. When such an agent is distilled into a smaller one, the harness stays in place, so the student mainly needs the teacher-specific abilities that the harness cannot provide, such as acting correctly on harness information. Standard distillation, however, imitates the teacher's full outputs and treats the harness as part of the input. We propose Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD), which focuses distillation on what the teacher adds beyond the harness. HAD complements on-policy distillation with two components: an action preference that contrasts the same teacher's actions with and without the harness information, scored after the student's own reasoning, and a validity check that drops preference pairs whose preferred action contradicts the harness records. We show that the contrast gives the student information that imitating the teacher alone cannot provide, and HAD needs no task rewards, success labels, or future information. Across multiple long-horizon agent benchmarks and models, HAD outperforms on-policy distillation baselines with the same fixed harness. Our analysis shows that HAD enters fewer unproductive loops and recovers from errors more often than the baselines, and suggests that it adaptively keeps learnable feedback in its weights while reading state information from the harness.

ru.title: Умная дистилляция агентов: учим модель тому, чему не может научить внешняя система
ru.desc: Статья предлагает метод Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD) для эффективной дистилляции больших языковых моделей, которые работают с внешней архитектурой (harness), управляющей контекстом и инструментами. Вместо того чтобы копировать полный вывод учителя, HAD фокусируется на том, что добавляет учитель сверх информации от harness, используя контрастивное обучение действий. Метод включает проверку валидности, которая отбрасывает противоречивые пары предпочтений, и не требует наград, меток успеха или будущей информации. Экспериментально показано, что HAD превосходит стандартные методы дистилляции, лучше избегает бесполезных циклов и эффективнее восстанавливается после ошибок.

en.title: Harnessing Knowledge for Smarter Distillation
en.desc: This paper introduces Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD), a new method for training smaller language model agents using a teacher model's knowledge while maintaining a harness that manages context and feedback. Unlike standard distillation, which treats the harness as part of the input, HAD focuses on the unique contributions of the teacher model beyond the harness. It incorporates an action preference mechanism that evaluates the teacher's actions with and without harness information, allowing the student model to learn more effectively. The results show that HAD improves performance on various benchmarks by reducing unproductive loops and enhancing error recovery, without requiring additional task rewards or labels.

zh.title: 提升语言模型的学习效率
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的蒸馏方法，称为“考虑工具的蒸馏”（HAD），旨在提高语言模型代理的学习效率。传统的蒸馏方法将教师的完整输出视为输入，而HAD则专注于教师在工具之外所提供的额外信息。HAD结合了行动偏好和有效性检查，帮助学生模型更好地理解和利用工具信息。实验结果表明，HAD在多个基准测试中表现优于传统的蒸馏方法，能够更有效地避免无效循环并从错误中恢复。

papers.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
papers.abstract: Abstract  Web agents complete user requests by reading and acting on pages that third parties write, so an instruction planted on a page can redirect the agent away from the user's goal. The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it. We introduce AdvSim2Real, which co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and the agent inside a frozen web world model. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the agent solves about half of the time, and the adversary only for a success flip, an injection that turns a judged success into a failure. Training in the simulator makes a 4B agent both more capable and more robust: its completion rises with and without attacks, holds against a frontier-model adversary it never trained against, and its capability gain carries over to a real browser. On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6\% relative to the base agent.
affiliations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

ru.title: Устойчивость веб-агентов через адаптивное состязательное обучение в симуляции
ru.desc: В работе решается проблема защиты веб-агентов от злонамеренных инъекций, которые могут отвлечь модель от цели пользователя. Авторы предлагают AdvSim2Real — метод совместного обучения, который одновременно развивает curriculum обучающих задач, адаптивного противника и самого агента в замороженной модели веб-среды. Метод использует симуляцию для обучения, где curriculum вознаграждается за задачи средней сложности, а противник — за успешные атаки, которые превращают успех в неудачу. Экспериментально показано, что 4B параметр агент становится одновременно способнее и устойчивее к атакам, улучшая результаты даже против ненаученного противника на реальном браузере с относительным приростом 33.6%.

en.title: Enhancing Web Agents with AdvSim2Real: Robustness through Co-evolution
en.desc: This paper presents AdvSim2Real, a novel approach to enhance the robustness of web agents against adversarial injections while they perform tasks. It introduces a co-evolutionary training framework that simultaneously develops a task curriculum, an adversarial injection model, and the agent itself within a simulated web environment. The training rewards the agent for solving tasks and penalizes it when an adversary successfully alters a task's outcome. As a result, the trained agent shows significant improvements in task completion rates, even when faced with unseen adversarial strategies, demonstrating its effectiveness in real-world applications.

zh.title: 提升网络代理鲁棒性的创新训练方法
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种新的训练方法AdvSim2Real，用于提高网络代理在面对恶意注入时的鲁棒性。该方法通过共同演化任务课程、注入对手和代理，来增强代理的能力。与传统方法不同，AdvSim2Real在模拟环境中进行训练，使代理在未见过的对手面前也能提高完成率。实验结果表明，该方法在150个网络任务中，相较于基础代理，完成率提高了33.6%。

papers.title: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract  We present DistScene, a framework for single-image compositional 3D scene generation by jointly modeling the environment and individual objects. Unlike existing methods that represent scenes primarily as collections of objects, we model the environment as an explicit scene component to provide geometric context for object placement. Specifically, we introduce Scene-Frame Generation, which jointly generates separate environment and object components in a shared coordinate frame, allowing their geometry and relative placement to be learned together. Then we introduce Object-Centric Refinement to refine each object in a local frame with scene context. Finally, we develop Object-to-Scene Distillation to transfer pretrained object-generation priors to scene generation through automatically composed and rendered synthetic scenes. Evaluations on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate improved scene-level spatial coherence over the evaluated baselines. Project page: https://coolbeam.github.io/DistScene/
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Совместная генерация окружения и объектов для реалистичных 3D сцен
ru.desc: DistScene — это фреймворк для генерации композиционных 3D сцен из одного изображения, который совместно моделирует окружение и отдельные объекты. В отличие от существующих методов, авторы представляют окружение как явный компонент сцены, обеспечивающий геометрический контекст для размещения объектов. Фреймворк использует три ключевых техники: совместную генерацию окружения и объектов в общей системе координат, уточнение каждого объекта в локальном фрейме с учетом контекста сцены, и дистилляцию знаний от предобученных моделей генерации объектов. Экспериментальная оценка на датасетах внутренних и внешних сцен показывает улучшение пространственной согласованности по сравнению с существующими методами.

en.title: Revolutionizing 3D Scene Generation with DistScene
en.desc: DistScene is a novel framework designed for generating 3D scenes from a single image by considering both the environment and individual objects together. It introduces Scene-Frame Generation, which allows for the simultaneous creation of the environment and objects in a unified coordinate system, enhancing their spatial relationships. The framework also features Object-Centric Refinement, which fine-tunes each object based on the surrounding scene context. Additionally, Object-to-Scene Distillation is employed to leverage existing object generation models, improving the overall coherence and quality of the generated scenes.

zh.title: 联合建模环境与物体的3D场景生成
zh.desc: 本文提出了DistScene框架，用于通过联合建模环境和单个物体来生成单幅图像的组合3D场景。与现有方法主要将场景视为物体集合不同，我们将环境建模为明确的场景组件，以提供物体放置的几何上下文。具体而言，我们引入了场景框架生成技术，在共享坐标框架中共同生成环境和物体组件，从而使它们的几何形状和相对位置能够一起学习。最后，我们开发了物体到场景的蒸馏方法，通过自动组合和渲染合成场景，将预训练的物体生成先验知识转移到场景生成中。

papers.title: HLA: Expressive Hybrid Linear Attention via Chunk-Wise Dynamic Mixing
papers.abstract: Abstract  Linear attention enables efficient long-context autoregressive decoding by compressing history into recurrent states, but this compression can make selective access to sparse and distant information difficult. Existing chunk-based extensions increase memory capacity, yet learned chunk-mixing coefficients may remain fixed with respect to input content and therefore cannot adapt historical access to each query. We introduce Hybrid Linear Attention (HLA), a query-dependent chunk-level attention mechanism for Gated DeltaNet (GDN). HLA represents each completed chunk as an exact affine state transition and computes content-dependent routing gates from compact, self-attentively pooled representatives. Each gate interpolates the corresponding historical transition with the identity map, controlling both the chunk's additive memory and its transformation of earlier states. Effective-support regularization further encourages concentrated routing for sparse inference. We evaluate HLA under both pretrained adaptation and from-scratch training. Across Qwen3.5 models from 0.8B to 9B, HLA consistently improves over native GDN and fixed chunk mixing, with gains of up to 5.57 percentage points on LongBench-V2 and 3.97 points on RULER. In a controlled from-scratch 1.3B setting trained for 100B tokens with a 4K context, HLA also improves RULER performance from 4K to 32K, with gains increasing from 0.83 points at 4K to 4.22 points at 32K. These results demonstrate that query-dependent composition of recurrent memory improves long-context modeling and remains effective beyond the training context while using compact per-chunk affine summaries. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla/

ru.title: Адаптивное управление памятью: запрос-зависимое внимание для длинных контекстов
ru.desc: Статья представляет Hybrid Linear Attention (HLA) — механизм адаптивного внимания для эффективной обработки длинных контекстов в языковых моделях. HLA решает проблему жесткого сжатия истории в линейном внимании, позволяя моделям динамически выбирать релевантную информацию из предыдущих блоков на основе содержания текущего запроса. Метод использует контент-зависимые параметры маршрутизации для интерполяции исторических переходов состояний, что улучшает способность модели работать с редкой и удалённой информацией. Экспериментальные результаты показывают значительные улучшения производительности на тестах долгоконтекстного моделирования, особенно при экстраполяции за пределы контекста обучения.

en.title: Enhancing Long-Context Modeling with Hybrid Linear Attention
en.desc: This paper presents Hybrid Linear Attention (HLA), a new mechanism designed to enhance long-context autoregressive decoding in machine learning models. HLA allows for better access to historical information by using query-dependent chunk-level attention, which adapts the way past data is accessed based on the current query. The method employs content-dependent routing gates that help manage how historical data is transformed and utilized, improving memory efficiency. Experimental results show that HLA significantly outperforms existing methods, leading to better performance in various tasks involving long-context data.

zh.title: 查询依赖的混合线性注意力提升长上下文建模
zh.desc: 线性注意力通过将历史信息压缩为递归状态，使得长上下文的自回归解码变得高效，但这种压缩可能导致对稀疏和远程信息的选择性访问变得困难。现有的基于块的扩展虽然增加了内存容量，但学习到的块混合系数可能对输入内容保持固定，无法根据每个查询自适应历史访问。我们提出了混合线性注意力（HLA），这是一种针对Gated DeltaNet (GDN) 的查询依赖块级注意力机制。HLA通过紧凑的自注意力池化代表计算内容依赖的路由门，显著提高了长上下文建模的效果。

papers.title: Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation with Cross-Platform User History
papers.abstract: Abstract  Modern recommendation is shifting from platform-centric personalization toward user-governed personalization, where a personal LLM agent can act on the user's behalf across services. We formalize this emerging paradigm as Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation: a platform recommender ranks a candidate set using platform-local information, and a personal agent uses user-authorized cross-platform history to mediate the resulting ranking and produce the final top-K slate. Such mediation is nontrivial: the platform ranking can encode strong population evidence that the personal agent cannot observe, so effective mediation must therefore balance beneficial rescues against harmful overrides. To study this trade-off, we introduce MediateRec, a benchmark that includes scalable proxy cross-platform environments and a real cross-platform test under a controlled platform-agent information boundary. To train the agent to use cross-platform history effectively, we further propose Personal Attribution Mediation Optimization (PAMO), which counterfactually masks that history to estimate personal mediation support and reallocates rank-aware advantage mass under a platform-relative value floor. We theoretically prove that PAMO preserves cutoff-level advantage mass and is locally optimal among first-order reallocations that preserve this mass without lowering average platform-relative value. Experiments on MediateRec show that personal-agent mediation enables meaningful platform corrections, yet even strong proprietary LLMs introduce non-negligible harmful overrides. PAMO consistently improves over matched outcome-only RL across seen and unseen target platforms and on the real cross-platform test, while achieving a better rescue-harm balance.

ru.title: Балансировка персональных предпочтений и популярности в кросс-платформной рекомендации
ru.desc: В статье представляется новая парадигма рекомендации, где персональный LLM-агент действует от имени пользователя и переранжирует рекомендации платформы, используя историю пользователя из разных сервисов. Авторы формализуют эту задачу как медиирующую рекомендацию, где нужно балансировать между полезными корректировками рейтинга и вредными переопределениями, которые идут вразрез с популярными трендами платформы. Для исследования этого компромисса предложены бенчмарк MediateRec с симуляциями и реальный тест, а также метод PAMO, который использует контрфактические маски для оценки поддержки персональной медиации и переаллокации преимуществ ранга. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что PAMO эффективнее базовых методов обучения с подкреплением и лучше балансирует между полезными и вредными переопределениями рейтинга.

en.title: Empowering Users with Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendations
en.desc: This paper introduces a new approach to recommendation systems called Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation, where a personal agent helps users make better choices across different platforms. The agent uses both platform-specific data and user-approved cross-platform history to refine recommendations, balancing the need to correct platform biases while avoiding harmful overrides. The authors present a benchmark called MediateRec to evaluate this approach and propose a method called Personal Attribution Mediation Optimization (PAMO) to enhance the agent's decision-making. Experiments show that PAMO improves the quality of recommendations by effectively managing the trade-off between beneficial corrections and harmful overrides.

zh.title: 用户主导的个性化推荐新范式
zh.desc: 现代推荐系统正从以平台为中心的个性化转向用户主导的个性化。在这种新兴范式中，个人代理可以代表用户在多个服务中进行操作。我们提出了个人代理中介推荐的概念，平台推荐系统使用平台本地信息对候选集进行排名，而个人代理则利用用户授权的跨平台历史来调整最终的推荐结果。为了有效地训练代理使用跨平台历史，我们提出了个人归因中介优化（PAMO），该方法在保持平台相对价值的基础上，优化了推荐的平衡。

papers.title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
papers.abstract: Abstract  Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

ru.title: Оживляем вставленные объекты: согласованное взаимодействие в видеоредактировании
ru.desc: Представлена система ALIVE для естественного встраивания объектов в видеоредактирование с их реалистичным взаимодействием с окружением. Авторы собрали датасет из 35,800 пар видео, содержащих трёхмерную графику, синтетические видео и реальные сцены, где целевой объект взаимодействует с исходным контентом. Модель обучается предсказывать инструкции взаимодействия, используя видение-языковую модель (VLM) для понимания сцены. Система достигла значительного улучшения на 43.9% в метриках качества взаимодействия и сохранения исходного видео по сравнению с базовыми методами.

en.title: Bringing Video Objects to Life with ALIVE
en.desc: The paper presents ALIVE, a framework designed to enhance video editing by enabling inserted objects to interact naturally with their environment. It utilizes a combination of edited frames and specific instructions to create coherent interactions between the added objects and the original video content. The authors curated a large dataset of 35,800 editing pairs to train a vision-language model (VLM) that predicts how these objects should behave in context. The framework significantly improves interaction fidelity and visual coherence, outperforming existing methods by a notable margin, especially when guided by the VLM.

zh.title: 让视频中的对象“活起来”
zh.desc: 当前的视频编辑工具可以插入对象，但在使这些对象参与交互方面存在困难。我们提出了ALIVE框架，使插入的对象能够通过与源视频内容的连贯交互变得“活跃”。我们收集了35800对编辑样本，结合了3D渲染、模型生成和真实世界视频，帮助编辑者学习协调的对象行为和源内容的保留。通过训练视觉-语言模型（VLM），我们能够从相同的输入中预测交互指导，从而提升了交互的真实感和视觉一致性。

papers.title: HiPLEX: Hierarchical Policy Factorization for Full Duplex Speech Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  As human--AI interactions become more conversational, full-duplex speech language models capable of natural real-time dialogue are growing in importance. Beyond generating appropriate responses, these models must coordinate turn-taking, backchanneling, and floor management in real time. Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a way to refine these behaviors through direct feedback on interaction outcomes. However, existing RL methods either apply timing feedback to a token policy or optimize semantic content, leaving the joint improvement of timing and content unresolved. We introduce HiPLEX, an RL framework that factorizes a pretrained full-duplex text policy into a control policy that decides when to emit content and a conditional content policy that decides what to emit. The first factor selects among 'pad', 'epad', and 'con'. The second selects a token only when 'con' is chosen. This hierarchy describes conditional actions within each frame and uses the model's existing text head. We route timing advantages to the token-group factor through event-causal masks derived from generated speech episodes, and route an LLM-judge semantic advantage to the conditional content factor. Across three Moshi seeds on Full-Duplex-Bench v1, HiPLEX reduces takeover rates during natural user pauses and backchannel opportunities, and shortens post-interruption response latency relative to GRPO, while maintaining comparable judged interruption-response quality. On Moshi and PersonaPlex, HiPLEX better matches pooled human turn-timing and backchannel-rate marginals than GRPO.

ru.title: Иерархическая политика для синхронизации времени и содержимого в диалоговых языковых моделях
ru.desc: В работе предложен HiPLEX — фреймворк глубокого обучения с подкреплением для улучшения полнодуплексных речевых языковых моделей в естественном диалоге. Метод факторизирует предварительно обученную политику на две компоненты: управляющую политику, которая определяет, когда издавать содержимое (pad, epad или con), и условную политику содержимого, которая выбирает токены при активации con. Обратная связь маршрутизируется через событийно-причинные маски для улучшения временного согласования и LLM-судьи для оптимизации семантического качества. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что HiPLEX снижает частоту захватов очереди, улучшает обработку прерываний и лучше соответствует человеческим паттернам разговора по сравнению с базовыми методами.

en.title: Enhancing Conversational AI with HiPLEX: Timing Meets Content
en.desc: This paper presents HiPLEX, a reinforcement learning framework designed to enhance full-duplex speech language models for more natural human-AI conversations. HiPLEX separates the decision-making process into two policies: a control policy that manages when to speak and a content policy that determines what to say. By using event-causal masks and leveraging feedback from a large language model, HiPLEX improves timing and content generation simultaneously. The results show that HiPLEX effectively reduces interruptions and improves response timing compared to existing methods, while maintaining high-quality interactions.

zh.title: 优化人机对话的全双工模型
zh.desc: 随着人机交互变得更加对话化，能够进行自然实时对话的全双工语音语言模型变得越来越重要。这些模型不仅需要生成合适的回应，还必须实时协调轮流发言、反馈和管理发言权。我们提出了HiPLEX，这是一个强化学习框架，通过将预训练的全双工文本策略分解为控制策略和条件内容策略，来优化发言时机和内容的联合改进。实验结果表明，HiPLEX在自然用户暂停和反馈机会期间减少了接管率，并缩短了中断后的响应延迟，同时保持了与现有方法相当的响应质量。

papers.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: Abstract  Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene: generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time. Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt, showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores. Building on these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.

ru.title: Интерпретируемость скрытых представлений в диффузионных трансформерах через естественный язык
ru.desc: В этой работе исследуются контекстные токены в мультимодальных диффузионных трансформерах (MM-DiT), которые обрабатывают текстовую и визуальную информацию одновременно. Авторы разработали специальную архитектуру-интерпретатор, которая переводит скрытые представления контекстных токенов в пространство входных данных больших языковых моделей, позволяя анализировать развивающееся изображение прямо из промежуточных представлений. Исследование показало, что контекстные токены кодируют богатую семантическую информацию о сцене, включая детали, которые становятся доступны на ранних этапах генерации, а затем постепенно уточняются. На основе полученных выводов авторы предложили метод Contextual Alignment для явного улучшения визуально-семантической информации в контекстных токенах, что повышает качество генерируемых изображений.

en.title: Unlocking the Secrets of Multimodal Contextual Tokens
en.desc: This paper presents Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) that integrate visual and textual data during the generation process. The authors explore how contextual tokens, which are updated through multimodal attention, can be interpreted using a lightweight network that connects them to a Large Language Model (LLM). Their findings reveal that these tokens contain rich semantic information about the generated images, even from minimal prompts, and that this information evolves over time during the denoising process. Additionally, they propose a training method called Contextual Alignment to enhance the quality of image generation by reinforcing the visual-semantic connections within these contextual tokens.

zh.title: 解码多模态生成的上下文信息
zh.desc: 多模态扩散变换器（MM-DiTs）能够同时处理视觉和文本表示。在生成过程中，这些模型通过多模态注意力不断更新文本标记，形成动态上下文标记。我们提出了一种框架，通过自然语言提问来解读这些上下文空间，并训练了一个轻量级的瓶颈网络，将中间上下文标记映射到冻结的大型语言模型（LLM）的输入空间。我们的研究表明，上下文标记编码了丰富的全局场景表示，生成特定的语义信息在去噪过程中很早就可以被访问，且随着时间推移，越来越细致的细节也变得可读。

papers.title: Learning Discriminative Geometry for Drifting Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Recently proposed Drifting Models shift iterative distribution refinement from inference to training, enabling effective one-step generation. However, their performance on complex image datasets depends strongly on the representation used to construct the drifting field: pixel-space drifting performs poorly, whereas pretrained feature spaces substantially improve sample quality for reasons that remain unclear. We trace this gap to the discriminative geometry of the representation, which determines sample weighting in kernel density estimation (KDE) and, consequently drift. We introduce persistent representation learning, which continuously learns a more discriminative representation geometry as the generator evolves across batches. We further establish a current-step gradient equivalence between the KDE ratio loss and drift regression loss under matched conditions, connecting density-ratio-based generator optimization to empirical drifting and motivating direct control of the drifting velocity. Across multiple datasets, our method learns effective discriminative representations directly from pixels and reduces FID by approximately 82-95% over the original pixel-space Drifting Models, without pretrained encoders. Adapting pretrained representations and applying velocity clipping provide further gains.

ru.title: Обучаемые представления для эффективной одношаговой генерации через дрейфующие модели
ru.desc: В статье исследуются Drifting Models — модели, которые сдвигают итеративное уточнение распределения с этапа инференса на этап обучения, позволяя генерировать изображения за один шаг. Авторы выявили, что производительность на сложных датасетах сильно зависит от геометрии представления, используемого для построения дрейфующего поля, особенно от дискриминативных свойств, влияющих на взвешивание образцов в оценке плотности. Они предложили метод persistent representation learning, который непрерывно обучает более дискриминативную геометрию представления по мере эволюции генератора между батчами. Установлена математическая эквивалентность между KDE ratio loss и drift regression loss, что позволило добиться значительного улучшения качества (снижение FID на 82-95%) без использования предобученных кодировщиков.

en.title: Enhancing Image Generation with Persistent Representation Learning
en.desc: This paper introduces a new approach called persistent representation learning to improve the performance of Drifting Models in generating images. The authors identify that using pixel-space representations leads to poor results, while pretrained feature spaces enhance sample quality. They explain that the effectiveness of these representations is linked to their discriminative geometry, which influences how samples are weighted in kernel density estimation (KDE). By continuously refining the representation as the generator learns, their method significantly reduces the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) by 82-95% compared to traditional pixel-space models, demonstrating the importance of effective representation in generative tasks.

zh.title: 持久表示学习：提升漂移模型的生成质量
zh.desc: 最近提出的漂移模型将迭代分布细化从推理转移到训练，使得一步生成变得有效。然而，它们在复杂图像数据集上的表现强烈依赖于用于构建漂移场的表示：像素空间漂移效果较差，而预训练特征空间显著提高了样本质量，原因尚不清楚。我们将这一差距追溯到表示的判别几何，这决定了在核密度估计（KDE）中的样本加权，从而影响漂移。我们引入了持久表示学习，随着生成器在批次间的演变，持续学习更具判别性的表示几何。

papers.title: JLD: Perceptual Distance Through A Jacobian Lens
papers.abstract: Abstract  Image compression, restoration, and generation all require a way to measure how different two images look to a person. Pixel error ignores how people see, while the most accurate perceptual distances are typically fitted to human judgments, tying them to a fixed data and resolution. For example, when image resolution is doubled, the correlation of DISTS with human scores on TID2013 drops from 0.815 to 0.717. We introduce the Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD), which derives its perceptual geometry from a frozen vision encoder rather than from human labels. JLD combines the locality of early patch features with the perceptual sensitivity captured by later encoder representations. Specifically, we use the encoder Jacobian to identify directions in the early feature space that most strongly affect the encoder output, producing a fixed metric tensor, E[J^top J], which we call the Jacobian lens. The lens is fitted only once from 100 unlabeled images, taking about 35 seconds. Locally, this construction defines a pullback metric in pixel space, giving JLD a clear geometric interpretation that can be directly analyzed on real images. Across four standard perceptual databases, JLD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms LPIPS, DISTS, PieAPP, and DreamSim. JLD is also robust to changes in image resolution, on TID2013, its lens-term correlation remains nearly unchanged when the resolution is doubled, decreasing only from 0.850 to 0.845. We further introduce JLD-fast, which is 4times faster than LPIPS-VGG while achieving a mean correlation of 0.911. Finally, JLD naturally extends to video, reaching a correlation of 0.786 on Waterloo IVC 4K compared with 0.611 for VMAF.
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin

ru.title: Геометрия восприятия из якобиана энкодера вместо разметки людей
ru.desc: В статье предложена новая метрика для оценки визуального качества изображений под названием Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD), которая основана на анализе якобиана замороженного визуального энкодера вместо подгонки под человеческие оценки. Метрика комбинирует локальную информацию из ранних слоёв признаков с перцептивной чувствительностью из глубоких представлений энкодера, создавая фиксированный метрический тензор. JLD демонстрирует устойчивость к изменениям разрешения изображения и превосходит существующие метрики вроде LPIPS и DISTS на стандартных бенчмарках. Метод также естественно расширяется на видео и имеет ускоренную версию, работающую в 4 раза быстрее стандартных решений.

en.title: Revolutionizing Image Perception with Jacobian Lens Distance
en.desc: The paper introduces the Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD), a new metric for measuring perceptual differences between images. Unlike traditional methods that rely on human judgments, JLD uses a frozen vision encoder to derive its perceptual geometry, making it more adaptable to changes in image resolution. By utilizing the encoder Jacobian, JLD identifies key features that influence the output, resulting in a robust and efficient metric. The method demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across multiple perceptual databases and is significantly faster than existing metrics, making it suitable for both image and video applications.

zh.title: 雅可比透镜距离：图像感知的新标准
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的图像感知距离度量方法，称为雅可比透镜距离（JLD）。与传统的像素误差不同，JLD通过冻结的视觉编码器来获取感知几何，而不是依赖于人类标签。JLD结合了早期特征的局部性和后期编码器表示的感知敏感性，能够在不同分辨率下保持稳定的性能。实验结果表明，JLD在多个标准感知数据库上表现优异，超越了现有的多种方法，并且在视频处理上也展现了良好的扩展性。

papers.title: Towards In-Parameter Memory Augmentation for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents increasingly need to incorporate knowledge acquired after pretraining, e.g., domain facts, user preferences, documents, and interaction experience. In-context learning (ICL) and ICL-based agent harness remain flexible, but they consume context capacity and incur repeated discretized encoding cost that grows with context length. In-parameter memory offers a complementary substrate: reusable memory information is represented in model parameters, adapters, or other parameter-like objects that are composed into the forward pass at inference time. This survey focuses on methods that augment LLMs with such parametric memory at deployment: a memory-bearing parameter object is plugged into the forward pass during inference, whether it is acquired before or during deployment. We organize the landscape with two orthogonal axes: Parameter Placement, which includes Embedding, Attention, FFN layers, or Hybrid when two or more layers are used; and Parameter Acquisition Time, which distinguishes methods whose memory object is acquired during deployment (online) from those acquired before it (offline). We clarify boundaries, conduct comparisons, and discuss open directions in interference, safety, co-design with ICL, and recursive self-improvement.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Параметрическая память вместо контекста: эффективное хранение знаний в модели
ru.desc: В статье рассматривается использование параметрической памяти для расширения возможностей больших языковых моделей. Авторы предлагают классификацию методов по двум направлениям: месторасположению памяти в архитектуре модели (слои эмбеддинга, внимания, FFN или их комбинации) и времени её получения (во время развёртывания или заранее). Параметрическая память, в отличие от контекстного обучения, хранит информацию в параметрах модели и адаптерах, что позволяет эффективнее использовать контекстное окно. Исследование обсуждает ключевые вызовы: взаимодействие между компонентами, безопасность и интеграцию с методами в контексте.

en.title: Enhancing LLMs with In-Parameter Memory for Better Knowledge Integration
en.desc: This paper discusses how Large Language Models (LLMs) can be improved by incorporating knowledge that is learned after their initial training. It introduces the concept of in-parameter memory, which allows models to use reusable memory stored in their parameters during inference, rather than relying solely on in-context learning. The authors categorize different methods of integrating this memory based on where it is placed in the model and when it is acquired, either before or during deployment. The paper also explores various challenges and future directions for enhancing LLMs with this memory approach, including issues related to safety and efficiency.

zh.title: 增强LLM的参数化内存方法
zh.desc: 最近，大型语言模型（LLMs）和基于LLM的智能体越来越需要在预训练后整合新知识，例如领域事实、用户偏好、文档和交互经验。上下文学习（ICL）虽然灵活，但会消耗上下文容量，并且随着上下文长度的增加，编码成本也会增加。参数内存提供了一种补充的方式：可重用的记忆信息以模型参数、适配器或其他类似参数的对象形式表示，并在推理时组合到前向传播中。本文调查了在部署时如何通过参数化内存增强LLM的方法，并对参数放置和参数获取时间进行了分类和比较。

papers.title: Attacca: Goal-Directed Control under State Continuity for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  A central capability of embodied agents is to accomplish complex objectives through sequences of interdependent tasks. Yet existing visual goal-conditioned policies underlying these agents are typically evaluated on isolated interactions where the target is already visible, and thus do not capture the conditions that arise during continuous long-horizon task execution. In such settings, each task begins from the state left by the previous one: the agent may end at a different position and orientation, the world may have been modified, and the next interaction target may lie outside the current field of view. As a result, agents relying on such policies may struggle to proceed to the next task when they cannot ground their target in the current observation. To address this challenge, we propose Attacca, a new approach that trains visual goal-conditioned policies on complete search-to-interact trajectories using goal images decoupled from the execution environment. Attacca uses context-decoupled goal sampling to pair each demonstration with a class-compatible masked goal image from another world, removing direct scene and pose correspondence. It learns dense current-view grounding through a target-mask prediction head, providing auxiliary supervision beyond action imitation. We further introduce behavioral-phase conditioning that teaches the policy to distinguish Search, Approach, and Interact stages and adapt its control as execution progresses. We evaluate Attacca on multiple short- and long-horizon embodied tasks in Minecraft. Our method achieves 39.0-47.5% clean success, improving over the strongest baseline by 1.7-2.4x. On long-horizon tasks, it attains 54%, 30%, and 28% completion, yielding up to a 7x improvement.

ru.title: Поиск и взаимодействие: обучение агентов с развязанными целевыми образами
ru.desc: В работе предложен метод Attacca для обучения визуально-управляемых политик агентов, которые должны выполнять сложные многошаговые задачи в реальных условиях. Основная идея заключается в использовании целевых изображений, отделённых от окружения выполнения, и контекстно-развязанной выборки целей для улучшения обобщения. Модель обучается предсказывать маски целевых объектов и различать три фазы поведения: поиск, приближение и взаимодействие. Эксперименты в Minecraft показывают значительное улучшение - до 7x по сравнению с базовыми методами на долгосрочных задачах.

en.title: Empowering Agents with Context-Aware Goal Learning
en.desc: This paper introduces Attacca, a novel approach for training visual goal-conditioned policies in embodied agents. Unlike traditional methods that evaluate agents in isolated scenarios, Attacca focuses on continuous task execution where the agent must adapt to changing environments and targets. It employs context-decoupled goal sampling to enhance learning by using goal images that are not tied to the current scene, allowing for better generalization. Additionally, Attacca incorporates behavioral-phase conditioning to help the agent recognize different stages of task execution, significantly improving performance on both short- and long-horizon tasks in Minecraft.

zh.title: Attacca：提升复杂任务执行的智能体策略
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为Attacca的新方法，旨在训练视觉目标条件策略，以应对复杂的任务执行。与传统方法不同，Attacca通过使用与执行环境解耦的目标图像，来进行完整的搜索-交互轨迹训练。该方法引入了行为阶段条件，使得策略能够区分搜索、接近和交互阶段，从而在执行过程中自适应控制。实验结果表明，Attacca在Minecraft中的多项短期和长期任务上表现优异，成功率显著提高。

papers.title: Judged Useless, Queried Anyway: Tool-Using Agents Rarely Turn Their Own Evidence Judgments into Stopping Decisions
papers.abstract: Abstract  An agent whose tool keeps returning nothing useful should stop relying on it. In a retrieval environment with controlled source failures, we separate how agents judge results from what they do. We compare stopping at the same step after longer and shorter runs of results the agent judged useless; this contrast is zero for clock- or deadline-driven stopping. Where we record their judgments, the seven agents we test call a failing source's results useless 97-100% of the time, yet most of them rarely stop on that judgment. Prompt cues change when they stop but not what they stop on. Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode can bring early stops regardless of evidence, a stated budget moves the 7-8B models' stops to the deadline, and a stopping rule or call cost in the prompt is followed at most partly. Stopping follows the evidence only when the harness enforces an integration step that makes the agent answer after five consecutive results it judged useless. This step raises failing-source success for every model, keeps the stopping point fixed when the budget doubles, and needs no extra judgment call when the agent states its judgments. A pre-registered replication on 300 fresh questions confirms the dissociation and the rule's effect.
